news.title: Major Radar Order to Support Ukraine Air Defence
news.text: HENSOLDT won a comprehensive order exceeding €340 million to deliver TRML-4D and SPEXER 2000 radars that strengthen Ukraine's air defence network.

news.title: First-Half 2025 Results Beat Revenue Expectations
news.text: HENSOLDT reported first-half 2025 revenue slightly above expectations, highlighting a record €7.1 billion order backlog and €1.4 billion order intake.

news.title: Citi Raises Price Target to EUR 106
news.text: Citi increased its HENSOLDT price target from EUR 88 to EUR 106 while maintaining a Hold rating due to the company's strong backlog momentum.

news.title: Kepler Capital Downgrades to Sell
news.text: Kepler Capital downgraded HENSOLDT to Sell on valuation concerns despite acknowledging the firm's robust fundamentals.
